messages:
emma: Heads-up — planning a small canary for release v1.4.0 this weekend. Proposed window Sat 02:00–04:00 UTC. Ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30 / 60 / 90 mins. Who can own deploy + smoke monitoring? I'll coordinate rollback readiness.
john: I can take the deploy, ok for Sat. What's the cohort selection — user slices or route-based?
emma: Target cohorts: 1) internal (team only) at 1%, 2) low-traffic API routes for 5%, 3) broader 20% but EXCLUDE enterprise tenants and dedicated-capacity customers. Route-based flags will make this simpler.
kai: I’ll own the smoke dashboards and alerts during the window. Preflight checklist?
olivia: Preflight asks: infra health, KV cache sanity, quantization metrics, and tracing retention bump to 48h for the window. Also confirm feature flag rollout names.
emma: Quick preflight checklist (short):
- run `./tools/deploy/preflight.sh v1.4.0`
- check `curl -sS https://api.redwood.dev/health | jq .`
- smoke prompt: `echo \"Summarize: redwood\" | ./bin/req -m local-test`
- ensure FF `rollout.wedge_v14` is configured for the three slices
- confirm autoscale targets and GPU headroom
Post results here once complete.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by john @ 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z — canary tag wedge-v1.4.0. Link: https://deploys.redwood/1778007654 (automated)
luis: Rollback knob is `traffic.router.set_weight(version=1.3.9, weight=100)`. Ops runbook: https://wiki.redwood/rollbacks#wedge. Keep that handy.
john: Rollback policy proposal: abort and roll to 1.3.9 immediately if we see >1% absolute error increase OR p95 latency > 500ms sustained for 5m. Sound good?
kai: Agreed. My watchlist: p95 latency, request_error_rate, kv_cache_miss_rate, token_cost_bump. I’ll put alerts to notify on Slack and call if escalation needed.
olivia: I'll run smoke scripts at 10/30/60 minutes after each ramp step. One-liner for reference:
```
for t in 10 30 60; do sleep ${t}m; ./smoke/run_smoke.sh --endpoint /chat --sessions 5; done
```
emma: Also plan fallback to a lighter model variant if memory pressure increases: route canary traffic to `gpt-small-v2`. Ops, confirm per-tenant exclusion is supported by router.
luis: Router supports tenant exclusion. I’ll add rule to exclude tenant tags: `enterprise`, `gov-*` before deploy starts.
john: I’ll tag the deploy `canary:wedge-weekend` and post start/finish times. ETA: pushing images 01:40 UTC, deploy at 02:00. Who will run post-deploy smoke?
kai: I will run the first smoke run and keep a one-line summary in this thread. If anything looks off, I’ll escalate immediately.
olivia: No infra blockers from my side. Please notify Support so they can expect possible noise in the early minutes.
emma: Thanks — I’ll compile a tiny runbook (commands, rollback steps, on-call list) and drop link 1h before the window. :thumbsup:
